# <span class="en">Data and study design</span><span class="zh">数据与研究设计</span> {#sec-data}

## <span class="en">Data sources</span><span class="zh">数据来源</span>

::: {.en}
Two datasets are combined. The conflict events come from the Armed Conflict
Location & Event Data Project [ACLED, @raleigh2010; @raleigh2023], as the
Myanmar extract distributed for this exercise. The township polygons are the
Myanmar Information Management Unit's township boundaries, version 9.4
[@mimu2024], downloaded from the MIMU GeoNode as a WFS shapefile export.
:::

::: {.zh}
本研究结合两套数据。冲突事件来自「武装冲突地点与事件数据项目」[ACLED,
@raleigh2010; @raleigh2023],使用本作业分发的缅甸数据摘录。镇区多边形采用缅甸信息
管理单位(MIMU)的镇区边界 9.4 版 [@mimu2024],以 WFS shapefile 导出的形式从
MIMU GeoNode 下载。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sources
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>The two input datasets as received. Row counts are before any cleaning.</span><span class='zh'>两套输入数据的原始状态。行数为任何清洗之前的数字。</span>"

tibble(
  Dataset = c("ACLED event data, Myanmar", "MIMU township boundaries v9.4"),
  `File` = c(audit$source_file, "mmr_polbnda_adm3_250k_mimu_1.shp"),
  Records = c(n_fmt(audit$n_raw), n_fmt(bnd$geom_report$n)),
  Coverage = c(paste(format(audit$date_range, "%d %b %Y"), collapse = " – "),
               paste0(n_fmt(bnd$area_geod_km2), " km² (geodesic)")),
  Geometry = c("Point (WGS 84 latitude / longitude)",
               "Polygon, 1:250,000, WGS 84"),
  `Key fields` = c("event_date, event_type, sub_event_type, latitude, longitude, geo_precision, admin3, fatalities",
                   "ST, DT, TS, TS_PCODE")
) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.en}
The ACLED file records `r n_fmt(audit$n_raw)` events in `r audit$n_cols`
fields, dated `r format(audit$date_range[1], "%d %B %Y")` to
`r format(audit$date_range[2], "%d %B %Y")`. Its latest modification
timestamp is `r format(audit$extracted, "%d %B %Y")`, a year after the study
window closes, so late reports and ACLED's routine revisions for the final
quarter should already be included. The MIMU layer holds
`r bnd$geom_report$n` townships, and `TS_PCODE` is a unique, complete
identifier for them.
:::

::: {.zh}
ACLED 文件在 `r audit$n_cols` 个字段中记录了 `r n_fmt(audit$n_raw)` 起事件,日期从
`r format(audit$date_range[1], "%Y 年 %m 月 %d 日")` 到
`r format(audit$date_range[2], "%Y 年 %m 月 %d 日")`。其最晚修改时间戳为
`r format(audit$extracted, "%Y 年 %m 月 %d 日")`,比研究窗口结束晚了一年,因此最后
一个季度的迟到报告与 ACLED 的例行修订应当都已包含在内。MIMU 图层包含
`r bnd$geom_report$n` 个镇区,`TS_PCODE` 是它们唯一且完整的标识符。
:::

## <span class="en">Study area, unit of analysis and time unit</span><span class="zh">研究区、分析单元与时间单元</span> {#sec-design}

```{r}
#| label: fig-study-area
#| fig-cap: "<span class='en'>Study area. The 329 townships of the analytical frame inside the MIMU state and region boundaries. Cocokyun, the one township left out (see @sec-prep-islands), is the small island group in solid grey in the Andaman Sea, south-west of the delta.</span><span class='zh'>研究区。分析框架中的 329 个镇区,及 MIMU 的省邦边界。唯一被排除的镇区 Cocokyun(见 @sec-prep-islands)是三角洲西南方安达曼海中以灰色实心显示的小群岛。</span>"
#| fig-alt: "Map of Myanmar showing 329 township polygons inside 17 state and region boundaries, with state names labelled."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 9

map_base(
  geom_sf(data = ts_an, fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = "#a8a29e", linewidth = 0.12),
  title = "Myanmar: 329 townships in MIMU's 18 state and region units",
  subtitle = "MIMU township boundaries v9.4, Albers equal-area projection"
) +
  geom_text(data = state_pts, aes(x, y, label = ST), size = 2.6,
            colour = "#1c1917", fontface = "bold", check_overlap = TRUE)
```

::: {.en}
**The township** is the spatial unit. It is the unit the brief asks for, and it
is also the finest unit that ACLED's own location coding supports across the
whole dataset. Of the conflict events analysed,
`r pct(100 * sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$prec2) / sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$analysed))`
carry `geo_precision` 2: ACLED knows the township but only places the event
"near" its main town. Treating those coordinates as points would put a
spurious concentration on every township seat. Aggregated to the township,
they are counted in the right place.

**The quarter** is the primary time unit, with months kept for sensitivity
analysis. A quarter gives `r N_Q` time steps, enough for a Mann-Kendall trend
test, while halving the share of empty township-periods from
`r pct(audit$pct_zero_m)` (months) to `r pct(audit$pct_zero_q)`. The choice
is tested in @sec-ehsa-sens.
:::

::: {.zh}
**镇区**是空间单元。这既是作业要求的单元,也是 ACLED 自身的位置编码在整个数据集上
所能支持的最细单元。在被分析的冲突事件中,
`r pct(100 * sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$prec2) / sum(audit$exclusion_by_type$analysed))`
的 `geo_precision` 为 2:ACLED 知道事件所在的镇区,但只能把它放在镇区主镇「附近」。
如果把这些坐标当作点,就会在每个镇区驻地制造出虚假的集中;汇总到镇区之后,它们
则被计入正确的位置。

**季度**是主要的时间单元,月度数据保留用于敏感性分析。季度提供 `r N_Q` 个时间步,
足以进行 Mann-Kendall 趋势检验,同时把空的镇区-时期占比从月度的
`r pct(audit$pct_zero_m)` 降到 `r pct(audit$pct_zero_q)`。这一选择在
@sec-ehsa-sens 中检验。
:::

## <span class="en">The armed-conflict variables</span><span class="zh">武装冲突变量</span> {#sec-vars}

::: {.en}
Five variables are built, each counted by township and by quarter. They are
kept apart because the three event types are produced by different actors
using different means, and there is no reason to assume they share a
geography.
:::

::: {.zh}
本研究构建了五个变量,均按镇区与季度计数。之所以分开处理,是因为三种事件类型由
不同的行动者以不同的手段造成,没有理由假定它们共享同一种地理分布。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-vars
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>The five armed-conflict variables. Counts are over the whole study period, after the location screening in @sec-prep-landmines.</span><span class='zh'>五个武装冲突变量。计数覆盖整个研究期,为 @sec-prep-landmines 中位置筛查之后的结果。</span>"

tibble(
  Variable = names(VARS),
  Label = unname(VARS),
  Definition = c(
    "Every event of the three types below",
    "Armed clashes between organised armed groups, and territory taken or retaken by force",
    "Air and drone strikes, shelling and artillery, remote explosives and IEDs, grenades: one side attacks without being physically present",
    "Attacks, abductions, sexual violence and other violence by an armed group against unarmed civilians",
    "Sum of ACLED's reported fatalities over the events above"),
  Total = c(n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$conflict)), n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$battles)),
            n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$erv)), n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$vac)),
            n_fmt(sum(ts_tot$fatalities))),
  `Townships with none` = c(sum(ts_tot$conflict == 0), sum(ts_tot$battles == 0),
                            sum(ts_tot$erv == 0), sum(ts_tot$vac == 0),
                            sum(ts_tot$fatalities == 0))
) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_width(Definition ~ px(380)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

::: {.en}
Protests, riots and strategic developments are excluded. They are recorded
by ACLED but are not armed conflict: a protest is a demonstration, and a
strategic development is a non-violent event such as an arrest, a troop
movement or an agreement. One borderline category deserves mention:
`r audit$excessive_force$n` events of "excessive force against protesters",
with `r audit$excessive_force$fatalities` reported deaths, mostly in the
first months of 2021, are filed by ACLED under protests. They describe lethal
state violence, but they belong to the crackdown that preceded the armed
conflict, and they are left out.
:::

::: {.zh}
抗议、骚乱与战略性事态被排除。ACLED 记录了它们,但它们不是武装冲突:抗议是示威,
战略性事态是逮捕、部队调动或协议之类的非暴力事件。有一个边界类别值得一提:
`r audit$excessive_force$n` 起「对抗议者过度使用武力」事件,报告死亡
`r audit$excessive_force$fatalities` 人,大多发生在 2021 年最初几个月,被 ACLED
归入抗议类别。它们描述的是致命的国家暴力,但属于武装冲突之前的镇压阶段,因此不计入。
:::

## <span class="en">Software</span><span class="zh">软件</span>

::: {.en}
The analysis is written in R. **sf** [@pebesma2018] handles the vector data;
**spdep** builds neighbour lists and weights and computes local Moran's I by
conditional permutation [@bivand2018]; **sfdep** [@parry2023] builds the
space-time cube and provides Gi\* and the reference EHSA implementation;
**Kendall** [@mcleod2022] computes the Mann-Kendall test. Maps are drawn with
**ggplot2**. Exact versions are listed in @sec-repro.
:::

::: {.zh}
分析使用 R 完成。**sf** [@pebesma2018] 处理矢量数据;**spdep** 构建邻接列表与权重,
并以条件置换计算局部 Moran's I [@bivand2018];**sfdep** [@parry2023] 构建时空立方体,
提供 Gi\* 以及作为参照的 EHSA 实现;**Kendall** [@mcleod2022] 计算 Mann-Kendall
检验。地图用 **ggplot2** 绘制。确切版本见 @sec-repro。
:::
